title: Divorced and Carrying the Crown Prince's Cub
author: Wuyue You
synopsis:
Meng Shuhe married Shen Qian, the heir of the Duke of Zhenguo’s estate, for three years, only to be rewarded with a notice of divorce. The reason was simply that the Heir despised her for being the true daughter who had grown up wandering in the countryside, completely devoid of proper upbringing.

The Heir wanted to marry Meng Ruoli, the fake daughter and the very model of a noble lady raised with proper aristocratic upbringing from the Marquis’s estate, as his wife. After being divorced, Meng Shuhe was drowning her sorrows in alcohol at a countryside estate when she had a one-night stand with Lu Jing, a scholar she had met back in Jiangnan.

Upon waking up, Meng Shuhe heard the voice of an infant in her womb calling her mother. It turned out that her son from fifteen years in the future had been reborn back to the very day she conceived him.

The child in her womb urged her to flee Chang'an and return to Jiangnan.

Only then did Meng Shuhe realize that the baby's father, Lu Jing, was not the ordinary person she had thought him to be...

chapters.title: The Child
chapters.content:
"Mother, Mother."

Inside the hibiscus gauze tent, the woman with a lovely sleeping face fluttered her long eyelashes at the sound of a child's voice.

"Mother, Mother."

Hearing the milky, infantile voice once more, Meng Shuhe slowly opened her eyes. Greeting her vision was the handsome sleeping face of the young lord beside her.

With a complexion smooth as jade, sharp sword-like brows, and closed eyes, the young lord beside her still radiated striking good looks.

"Mother, stop looking at Dad and hurry up and get up so we can run away!"

Meng Shuhe heard the childish little voice again. She sat up from the couch and looked around:

"Where is this child coming from? How could there be a child in my room?"

"Mother, I'm inside your belly. I am your son, Lu Xiu."

Meng Shuhe lowered her gaze to gently stroke her lower abdomen, full of astonishment as she listened to the childish voice: "My son? Where on earth did I get a son?"

Though Meng Shuhe had been married for three years, her husband had never once touched her.

Yesterday, after receiving the notice of divorce, she was overcome with anger and grief, and drowned her sorrows in alcohol with Lu Jing, a scholar lodging at her estate.

She had only slept with the man last night after drinking... How could there suddenly be a child?

"Mother, I really am your son. My name is Lu Xiu, and I am the child of you and Lu Jing."

"I traveled back from fifteen years in the future to the exact moment you just conceived me. I'm right here in your belly."

Meng Shuhe pinched the webbing of her thumb. It hurt; she wasn't dreaming.

Yet this was simply too absurd.

Just like that, after a single night, she was already pregnant with a child?

Meng Shuhe asked in disbelief, "Why did you come back from fifteen years in the future?"

"I don't know either. Yesterday, I was punished by His Majesty the Emperor, forced to stand out in the rain, and I fainted from a high fever that wouldn't break. When I woke up, I had traveled back fifteen years to the day you just conceived me."

Hearing the child's voice, Meng Shuhe got off the couch and searched everywhere in her boudoir, but she didn't see any child playing tricks or making those sounds.

So only one possibility remained: the child was truly inside her belly!

Lu Xiu's milky voice sounded both helpless and anxious: "Mother, I really am inside your belly. Stop doubting me and hurry up and run away."

Meng Shuhe put on her clothes and coiled her long hair into a bun with a hairpin. "This is the estate from my dowry. Why should I run?"

Lu Xiu let out a soft sigh and said, "Yesterday, you got Dad drunk and slept with him. Later, relying on your pregnancy and your unborn child to elevate your status, you entered the Eastern Palace and became the Crown Princess. However, Dad doesn't like you at all; he has another love in his heart..."

Meng Shuhe spoke in a low voice, "Wait... Didn't you say your father is Lu Jing? The Crown Princess of the Eastern Palace? Lu Jing... is the Crown Prince?"

Lu Xiu nodded. "Mm, Lu Jing is the Crown Prince now."

Meng Shuhe looked in disbelief at the man sleeping soundly on the couch.

Meng Shuhe and Lu Jing had known each other since they were fifteen, but back then she was merely the daughter of a small-time vendor in Jiangnan, not yet the legitimate daughter of the Pingyuan Marquis's estate.

At that time, both Lu Jing and she were studying at the Wanhe Academy.

Meng Shuhe's family dim sum stall was set up right outside the academy gates, and Lu Jing would occasionally come by to eat her pastries.

Lu Jing was good-looking, and every time Meng Shuhe served him a few extra pieces of dim sum, Lu Jing would help her with the homework assigned by her teacher.

Later on, Meng Shuhe was found by the Meng family and learned that she was actually the eldest daughter of the Pingyuan Marquis's estate in Chang'an City.

Her departure from Jiangnan was so hurried that she arrived in Chang'an without even getting to say goodbye to Lu Jing.

Having lived in Chang'an City for four years, Meng Shuhe had almost forgotten about Lu Jing, never expecting to run into him on her way to recuperate at the estate.

Lu Jing had come to Chang'an City to participate in the imperial spring examinations, but he had been robbed by bandits, lost all his money, and had nowhere to go.

Remembering how he had previously patronized her adoptive parents' business, Meng Shuhe had allowed him to stay temporarily at the estate.

Never in her wildest dreams had Meng Shuhe imagined that Lu Jing was actually the Crown Prince!

A dignified Crown Prince had actually disguised himself as a poor scholar to freeload meals at her estate?

Lu Xiu continued, "Mother, Dad has always had someone in his heart. That's why he's almost twenty now, yet there are still no consorts in the Eastern Palace, all because he wants to remain pure for the woman he loves.

"Yesterday, you got him drunk and forcefully took his chastity. He was furious at first, but constrained by the fact that the Pingyuan Marquis is a decorated war hero, and that you had already conceived me, he had no choice but to confer upon you the title of Crown Princess."

Meng Shuhe murmured, "Last night... it wasn't I who got him drunk, nor was it I who forcefully took his chastity. Both he and I were drunk."

She and Shen Qian had been married for three years, and Shen Qian had never touched her.

He had merely sent his subordinates to deliver a notice of divorce. Enraged and aggrieved, Meng Shuhe had acted on impulse after drinking and slept with Lu Jing...

Thinking back on it after sobering up, she really shouldn't have done it.

Lu Xiu said, "Mother, after marrying Dad by virtue of your son, you were trapped in the inner palace for fifteen years. Dad didn't love you, and his resentment even spilled over to me, holding me in extreme disgust.

"An inner palace like that isn't worth staying in anyway. Let's pack our things and return to Jiangnan."

Looking at the young lord sleeping soundly on the bed, Meng Shuhe gently stroked her lower abdomen: "Even if there's someone else in his heart, as Empress and ruler of the Six Palaces holding immense power, isn't that much better than returning to Jiangnan?"

Lu Xiu's little milky voice grew anxious: "But Mother, your position as Empress isn't secure either. Fifteen years from now, both your position as Empress and my position as Crown Prince will be hanging by a thread.

"There are rumors in Chang'an City that Dad has already found the woman he loved in his youth, and wants to make her Empress, intending to depose both the Empress and the Crown Prince."

"We, mother and son, might not even be able to save our lives. Father punishing me to kneel in the rain was definitely meant to take my life..."

"Mother, let's hurry and escape back to Jiangnan. I don't want this father anymore."

Meng Shuhe said, "Returning to Jiangnan is fine, but there is one thing I must do before we go."

Meng Shuhe picked up a letter of divorce from the table.

This notice of divorce had been sent by her husband of three years, Shen Qian, the young heir of the Duke of Zhenguo's estate, via his subordinates.

"A notice of divorce?" Lu Xiu said. "I almost forgot, Mother, you were married to someone else before."

"So you were just divorced at this very moment? Damn blind-eyed bastards! How dare they divorce my mother!"

Meng Shuhe tightly clutched the divorce letter in her hand, wondering for a moment if her sanity had snapped after being divorced, making her actually believe that the child in her womb was talking to her, or if she truly had an extra child inside her belly?

If it was truly as the child in her womb said; that Lu Jing was the Crown Prince, that the two of them had married because of a child, and that Lu Jing had another beloved woman he wanted to stay pure for, then it would be best for her to draw a clear line between herself and Lu Jing.

As a divorced woman, marrying a second time into the Eastern Palace would probably be difficult to begin with.

Not to mention that Lu Jing had another beloved in his heart.

Holding the divorce letter, Meng Shuhe walked out of her bedchamber and instructed Lan'er, the maid at the door, "Lan'er, prepare the carriage. We're going to the Duke of Zhenguo's estate."

Lan'er nodded and complied, "Yes, Miss. I'll go prepare the carriage right away."

"Mother, what are you going to the Duke of Zhenguo's estate for?"

Meng Shuhe smiled faintly: "If there's going to be a divorce letter, it should rightly be me divorcing him, Shen Qian.

"For three years of marriage, he has trampled upon me so, and wasn't even willing to deliver the divorce letter in person. Naturally, I must go to the Duke of Zhenguo's estate to demand justice."

chapters.title: Marrying Another
chapters.content:
Chang'an City was lovely at the end of the second month, the sunshine bright and the willows by the stream just beginning to bud.

Meng Shuhe's carriage reached the street outside the Duke of Zhenguo's estate, but with about half a li still to go, it was blocked at the mouth of the road by the carriages parked ahead.

Lan'er went forward to see why the way was blocked, and after a while she returned to the carriage to report.

"Miss, I heard the Duke of Zhenguo's estate is holding a wedding today, and the guests' carriages are blocking the road. You are the Heir's wife of the Duke of Zhenguo's estate, at the very least. How could they hold a wedding without even telling you?"

Seeing Lan'er so full of righteous indignation, Meng Shuhe smiled faintly. "Yesterday the Duke of Zhenguo's estate sent me the divorce letter. In their eyes, I am no longer the Heir's wife."

Lan'er said in shock, "A divorce letter? Miss, how can the Duke of Zhenguo's estate divorce you? What right do they have?"

"Three years without a child," Meng Shuhe said evenly. "That already breaks one of the seven grounds for divorce."

"But you have had no child in three years because the Heir has never once set foot in your room."

Lan'er could not help being furious. "How could you possibly have borne a child?"

Meng Shuhe let Lan'er help her down from the carriage.

The moment they stepped down, the two of them heard the guests who had come to the Duke of Zhenguo's estate talking all around them.

"How is it that today Heir Shen of the Duke of Zhenguo's estate is marrying a daughter of the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate as his Heir's wife again?

I remember Heir Shen married the Marquis of Pingyuan's eldest daughter three years ago, didn't he?

And I never heard that his previous wife had passed away."

"Then you don't know. The Marquis of Pingyuan's estate has two eldest daughters, you see.

Meng Ruoli, who was raised for sixteen years as the Meng family's young lady, is not actually the Marquis and his wife's own child. She was swapped by mistake back then.

The true Meng daughter only came to Chang'an from the countryside at sixteen.

The Shen and Meng families already had a marriage contract between them, and three years ago both families agonized over whether it should fall on the true daughter or the false one.

The true daughter may be of Meng blood, but she grew up in the countryside with no manners to speak of, and was not fit to be the future mistress of the Duke of Zhenguo's estate.

But the false daughter, after all, is not a Meng either, and nobody even knows who her real parents are.

In the end it was the old madam of the Duke of Zhenguo's estate who decided it: the true daughter, left to drift in the countryside, would marry Heir Shen as the Heir's wife."

"Heir Shen is the elegant young gentleman everyone in Chang'an praises. Marrying a woman from the countryside was surely a waste of him, wasn't it?"

"Exactly. But good things take time. That true daughter from the countryside has borne no child in three years and has been cast aside, so now Heir Shen of the Duke of Zhenguo's estate can marry Meng Ruoli, who was raised with the proper training of a noble lady in the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate, as his Heir's wife."

Meng Shuhe raised an eyebrow slightly at this. Shen Qian had only handed her the divorce letter yesterday, and today he was marrying Meng Ruoli with all this fanfare?

Lan'er said, indignant once more, "Miss, the Shen family is bullying you far too much. How can the Heir divorce his wife and marry another?"

"I am so angry!"

Lu Xiu's baby voice was full of fury. "Mother, the Shen family has actually bullied you this much! If I could go back, I would surely take advantage of still being Crown Prince to give the Shen family a thorough beating!"

Meng Shuhe gently rested a hand on her lower abdomen and looked at Lan'er beside her. "Did you hear the voice of a baby just now?"

Lan'er shook her head. "No, Miss. Is there a baby's voice here?"

Meng Shuhe could not help wondering whether she had truly been driven mad by anger.

Just the matter of Lu Jing being the Crown Prince was already hard enough to believe.

If he really were the Crown Prince, would he have spent this past month freeloading on food and drink at her home?

"It's nothing. Let's go to the Duke of Zhenguo's estate."

At the gate of the Duke of Zhenguo's estate, Meng Shuhe saw the character for "double happiness" pasted on the door and red silk hanging from the plaque. Guests filled the place, and it was very lively.

The palace lanterns hanging high were plainly marked with the double-happiness character.

Second Master Shen and Madam Shen the Second, who were greeting guests outside the gate, were beaming with delight.

Until they saw Meng Shuhe in her plain clothes, and the two froze on the spot.

Meng Shuhe stepped forward with a light smile. "Second Uncle, Second Aunt, what a joyous occasion the household is holding today, and how lively it is. Why did no one come to the country estate to tell me there was a celebration at home, so that I could come and help you receive the guests?"

Madam Shen the Second raised her eyes to look at Second Master Shen.

Second Master Shen had not expected Meng Shuhe to come either, and his eyes were full of embarrassment.

Meng Shuhe said, "Second Uncle, such a grand display today. I wonder who is getting married?"

Second Master Shen hurriedly signaled a servant boy to go and report to the Duchess of Zhenguo.

Not far off, the sound of ceremonial music came in waves.

Meng Shuhe looked over and saw her "husband" Shen Qian riding at the head on a great red horse. His red robes set off his handsome features, and the elegant young gentleman drew plenty of praise from passersby.

Meng Shuhe walked up and stopped beside the red horse, then raised her eyes to the Heir of the Duke of Zhenguo's estate, Shen Qian, in his red robe. "Husband, are you taking a concubine today? Why would taking a concubine need such a grand display?"

Shen Qian had never imagined Meng Shuhe would come to the Shen family. He tightened his grip on the reins, and his lofty eyes were full of contempt for her.

Meng Shuhe was beautiful, to be sure, but she was a woman raised in the countryside without manners or breeding, raised among petty merchants, and she carried a stink of coppers about her.

Shen Qian's voice was cold and arrogant. "Who is your husband? Did you not receive the divorce letter I gave you yesterday?"

"A divorce letter?" Meng Shuhe said. "What divorce letter? Husband, you want to divorce me?"

Meng Wang, the Heir of the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate, who was riding behind the bridal sedan to see off the bride, rode forward and scolded Meng Shuhe angrily:

"Meng Shuhe, you have already been cast out by the Shen family. Why are you not staying properly at the country estate, and instead coming here to disgrace yourself?"

Meng Shuhe ignored her own elder brother and looked straight at Shen Qian. "Husband, how is it that I did not know I had been cast out?"

The groom had arrived with his bride at the gate, and the guests and neighbors who had come to watch were everywhere.

Seeing that Meng Shuhe had come to make trouble, they whispered in twos and threes, watching the show.

Shen Qian frowned. "Meng Shuhe, I have already sent someone to deliver the divorce letter to you. You have borne no heir in three years, which breaks one of the seven grounds, and you should be divorced."

Meng Shuhe laughed. "How truly laughable. On the day I married you, you said you had official duties and left for half a year.

Then Grandmother died, and you used three years of mourning as your reason for not coming to my room.

To this day you have never set foot in my room, never consummated our marriage with me. How could I have had an heir?"

Shen Qian looked at Meng Shuhe with fury in his eyes. "You woman from the countryside truly have no idea what manners are. How dare you speak of consummation in front of everyone, as a woman? Have you no shame?"

Meng Shuhe smiled faintly. "You are capable of divorcing a wife for no reason and marrying another, and that counts as manners? Where does taking two Heir's wives come from, if not from manners?"

Shen Qian said, "Meng Shuhe, you have already been divorced for having no child."

Meng Shuhe looked up at Shen Qian. "Heir, I do not accept this divorce letter. Why I have no child, you know perfectly well.

And besides, divorce comes with the seven grounds and the three exceptions. You say you divorce me for having no child, but I never stopped you from taking a concubine and having sons; it was you who refused to have children because of mourning.

And I also fall under one of the three exceptions, the one for having observed three years of mourning. I kept the three years of mourning for Grandmother together with you and fulfilled my duty as a granddaughter-in-law. How can you casually divorce your wife and marry another?"

Seeing from horseback the guests outside the gate pointing and whispering about him, Shen Qian could not help frowning at Meng Shuhe.

"I do not like you, so why force yourself to stay in the Shen family? It would be better to part on good terms."

Meng Shuhe said coldly, "You wasted three years of my life and made me bear the name of a remarried woman for no fault of mine, and you divorce me on the grounds of having no child. This is what you call parting on good terms?"

Meng Wang dismounted, stepped forward, and grabbed Meng Shuhe's wrist. "Meng Shuhe, stop disgracing the Meng family in front of everyone. Having no child, you should have been divorced in the first place."

"How laughable. My husband has never once entered my room. If I had had a child, would I not deserve to be divorced even more?"

Meng Shuhe sneered. "Elder Brother, you are my own full-blooded eldest brother. You do not help me seek justice, and today you even side with the Shen family to bully me?"

Meng Wang's hands shook with rage at Meng Shuhe, and he dragged her along by force. "Stop embarrassing us. Come back to the Meng family with me!"

chapters.title: Divorcing the Husband
chapters.content:
Meng Shuhe shook off Meng Wang’s hand holding her wrist, her voice growing even colder and more detached.

"Brother, exactly who is making a fool of themselves here today? Today, the heir and I are still husband and wife. If Sister Ruoli is so eager to put on the bridal gown and get into the sedan chair, the one making a fool of herself will be her..."

Hearing this, Meng Wang was infuriated and raised his hand to strike Meng Shuhe across the face.

Meng Shuhe quickly raised her hand to block Meng Wang's slap. "The dignified heir of the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate actually wants to hit a weak woman? What a wonderful skill you have. Eldest brother, you're doing a fantastic job bringing honor to the Meng family."

Meng Wang’s face turned ashen with anger.

At this moment, a richly dressed matron emerged from the State Duke’s estate.

"Shuhe, why aren't you properly recuperating at the estate? How is it that you've run back here?"

The Duchess of the State State furrowed her brows in displeasure. How could those servants at the manor let Meng Shuhe come and make a scene right outside the State Duke's estate on such an important day?

Didn't the servants at the manor know to keep a close eye on Meng Shuhe? Hadn't she told them not to let Meng Shuhe leave the manor without an order?

"Qian'er, you and Ruoli go inside first to perform the wedding bows. Make sure you don't miss the auspicious hour."

Hearing the Duchess's words, Shen Qian dismounted his horse.

Meng Shuhe let out a cold laugh. "You all go ahead and perform the wedding ceremonies, but I am heading straight to the Chang'an Metropolitan Governor's yamen to accuse Shen Qian, Heir of the State Duke's estate, of taking two wives, in violation of the laws of the Great Sheng."

The Duchess said, "Did you not receive the letter of divorce sent to you by the servants?"

Meng Shuhe replied, "Shen Qian's letter of divorce holds no validity. I have not violated the 'seven grounds for divorce', and even if I had, there are still the 'three exceptions'. I observed three full years of mourning for my grandmother and accompanied her on her final journey; you Shen family have no grounds to divorce me."

"Elder sister."

A woman wearing magnificent wedding attire stepped out from the bridal sedan chair. She covered her face with a round fan, her voice sounding exceptionally pitiful and sweet.

"Elder sister, I know you still resent me for taking away the sixteen years of wealth and privilege that should have been yours. But when all is said and done, this marriage betrothal was originally between myself and the Heir of Shen. Why must you stubbornly force a pair of resentful spouses together?"

Meng Wang looked at Meng Shuhe with disdain. "Look at that. Our younger sister is far more sensible than you.

I know you were raised in the countryside and don't understand the rules, but you've been back for more than three years now, it's about time you learned some manners of a noble family's daughter!

Meng Shuhe, which noble daughter is as shameless as you, bringing up the bridal chamber in front of a massive crowd?"

Meng Shuhe heard a voice coming from her lower abdomen: This uncle is so sickening! Ugh, I spit on him! No wonder he dies young! How could a person like this be my uncle?

Hearing that Meng Wang was going to die young, Meng Shuhe’s anger dissipated quite a bit.

Meng Shuhe looked at Meng Ruoli, whose face was hidden behind the round fan. "When was this marriage betrothal ever yours?"

Meng Wang said, "If not for Ruoli's good reputation, the Shen and Meng families would never have arranged this marriage so early on."

Meng Shuhe laughed. "Is that so? If the marriage was arranged because of Meng Ruoli's good reputation, then why did the old matriarch of the Shen family want me to marry into the Shen family? Why did she determine that I was to be her grand-daughter-in-law?"

Meng Ruoli stood to the side, weeping softly with an expression of profound grievance.

Seeing Meng Ruoli cry, Shen Qian spoke in a gentle, comforting voice, "Ruoli, I will definitely marry you."

"Qian-lang, but... Elder Sister is unwilling to be divorced... I don't want to put you in a difficult position, nor do I want you to become the laughingstock of others."

Meng Ruoli said softly, "I am willing to step aside. I don't want your reputation to suffer on my account."

Shen Qian tightly grasped Meng Ruoli's hand. "Ruoli, I will definitely marry you today."

Shen Qian glared at Meng Shuhe. "Today, no one can stop Ruoli and me from performing the wedding bows."

Meng Shuhe walked up to Shen Qian's side. "For now, I am still your legally wedded primary wife. Even if you bow with her in marriage, she will not be your wife, but a concubine. If Sister wishes to be a concubine, I will naturally fulfill your wishes."

Meng Ruoli looked at Meng Shuhe with eyes filled with hatred. This Meng Shuhe was truly arrogant to the extreme.

The Duchess frowned at Meng Shuhe, her tone dripping with disdain. "Meng Shuhe, don't you get too arrogant."

Meng Shuhe retorted, "The ones being arrogant are clearly your Shen family, thinking that because I came to Chang'an City from the countryside, I can be bullied at will. Don't even dream of divorcing me for no reason today."

Shen Qian took a deep breath, stepped up to Meng Shuhe, and lowered his voice. "Meng Shuhe, if you truly like me this much and are unwilling to leave me, then I will reluctantly allow you to become my honorable concubine, and I will go to your chambers to father a child with you..."

Meng Shuhe felt a wave of nausea.

The little bun's voice came from her belly: Mother, hit him! Hurry and slap him! This Shen Heir is truly disgusting!

Meng Shuhe looked at Shen Qian. "If you want to successfully perform the wedding bows with Meng Ruoli today, I can grant your wish, but I have two conditions. First, you must return all of my dowry to me in full."

"That is only natural," Shen Qian said in a deep voice. "You may take your dowry and leave whenever you please."

Meng Ruoli, however, grew somewhat anxious. The materials originally prepared by the Meng family for her own dowry were of the absolute finest quality.

That carved canopy bed alone had taken craftsmen fifteen years of painstaking effort to build, and it had later become Meng Shuhe's dowry.

If she allowed Meng Shuhe to just take it away now, it would truly be a bargain for her.

Meng Shuhe continued, "The second condition is that your State Duke's estate must give me one hundred thousand taels of silver in cash.

Only then will I write a letter of divorcing my husband, severing all ties with you, Shen Qian, from this day forward, and allowing you to happily marry Meng Ruoli today."

"One hundred thousand taels?"

The Duchess of the State Duke's estate let out a sharp cry of disbelief. "Do you have any idea how much one hundred thousand taels of silver is?"

Meng Shuhe nodded slightly. "I know. Since the Shen Heir is so deeply devoted to my sister, and to prevent her from being reduced to a mere concubine, coughing up one hundred thousand taels surely isn't a difficult task for your Shen family."

Shen Qian said, "Mother, just give her the one hundred thousand taels. A wife who is unworthy of virtue ruins three generations. If she is unwilling to leave the Shen family, our family will suffer for three generations, just think of it as spending money to buy peace and quiet."

The Duchess said anxiously, "Where are we supposed to get one hundred thousand taels in cash right now?"

Shen Qian replied, "Just send someone to draw it from the money shop."

Meng Shuhe added, "There's no need to make a trip to the money shop. Silver banknotes are acceptable as well."

The corners of the Duchess's mouth twitched slightly. It wasn't that she didn't have one hundred thousand taels of silver in cash; even a hundred thousand taels in banknotes was something she couldn't produce on such short notice.

Meng Wang frowned. "Meng Shuhe, you really were raised in the countryside living in poverty; your eyes are filled with nothing but profit and money."

Meng Shuhe merely rolled her eyes at Meng Wang. The Shen family, after all, was heavily indebted to her.

If Shen Qian looked down on her and was unwilling to take her as his wife, why didn't he say so three years ago, wasting three years of her youth in vain and saddling her with the reputation of a second-hand marriage?

If she weren't pregnant right now and planning to return to Jiangnan, even if they gave her two hundred thousand taels of silver, she would still insist on staying in the Shen family just to make their lives miserable.

The Duchess took a deep breath and ordered the accountant to calculate the silver.

Meng Shuhe whispered a brief instruction to Lan'er, who nodded and went to the carriage to fetch paper and brush.

The accountant brought over the banknotes, and the head mammy by the Duchess's side also retrieved the Duchess's personal private savings. Pieced together from various sources, they finally managed to scrape together one hundred thousand taels in banknotes.

Meng Shuhe took the banknotes, roughly counted them over, and placed the piece of Xuan paper Lan'er had brought onto a stone lion, picking up the brush to write the three characters: Letter of Divorce.

After dashing off the letter of divorce in fluid strokes, Meng Shuhe tossed it to Shen Qian:

"Remember, today it is I, Meng Shuhe, who am divorcing you, Shen Qian."

Shen Qian caught the letter of divorce tossed by Meng Shuhe. He looked at the ink, which was still wet.

The characters on the divorce letter were as graceful as startled swans and as vigorous as swimming dragons. Meng Shuhe, raised in the countryside, could actually write such fine calligraphy.

While marveling inwardly, Shen Qian looked up at Meng Shuhe. Seeing her and her maid counting banknotes with an utterly mercenary expression, a wave of contempt and disdain rose once again in his eyes.

Meng Ruoli whispered to Shen Qian, "Qian-lang, the auspicious hour is almost passing."

Shen Qian smiled lightly at Meng Ruoli beside him. Meng Ruoli, gentle, dignified, and the epitome of a virtuous noble lady, was the only one worthy of being his wife as the Heir.

When Meng Ruoli entered the estate alongside Shen Qian, her peripheral vision through the gap of the round fan caught sight of Meng Shuhe, who was blinded by the sight of money, and her heart filled with disdain.

Meng Shuhe thought she had come out ahead, but having been raised in the countryside, if she ever wanted to remarry in the future, she probably wouldn't be able to marry into any noble or aristocratic families.

At nearly twenty years of age, being able to marry the son of a minor official would already be the absolute limit.

So what if Meng Shuhe was the true legitimate daughter of the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate? In the future, she would never marry as well as herself, and she would forever be suppressed by her status as the wife of the Heir to the State Duke.

Meng Ruoli was just waiting to see the day when Meng Shuhe, who was being so arrogant today, remarried into some humble household in the future and was forced to humble herself and bow before her.

chapters.title: Returning to Jiangnan
chapters.content:
Meng Shuhe carefully counted the banknotes a second time. A full one hundred thousand taels in banknotes, not a single coin short.

Meng Shuhe looked toward the servants of the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate who were carrying Meng Ruoli's dowry behind the bridal sedan chair and instructed, "Put down the dowry for now and follow me into the State Duke's estate to move my own dowry out."

The servants of the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate looked at each other in dismay.

Meng Wang shouted angrily from the side, "Meng Shuhe, is taking one hundred thousand taels of silver not enough for you? Today is our younger sister's day of great joy; why on earth must you insist on taking your dowry away today?"

Meng Shuhe couldn't even be bothered to pay attention to this brainless brother of hers who couldn't tell the difference between right and wrong. She simply looked at the motionless servants of the Marquis of Pingyuan and said, "Are my orders no longer working on you?"

"Or do you no longer consider me the young lady of the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate?"

The footmen of the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate hurriedly set down the dowry they were carrying and bowed to Meng Shuhe, saying, "Young Mistress."

Meng Shuhe strode into the State Duke's estate, leading the footmen around the grand hall where the wedding bows had been performed, and headed toward the courtyard where she used to live.

When they reached the outside of the courtyard where she had spent the last three years, maids and matrons dressed in red were waiting outside, craning their necks in anticipation.

Seeing Meng Shuhe approach, the maids and matrons were stunned: "W-Wife? Madam?"

Ignoring them, Meng Shuhe walked straight into the courtyard, only to see that the window lattices and doors were all pasted with double-happiness characters.

Inside the room, dragon-and-phoenix wedding candles and the nuptial wine cups were prominently displayed on a round table.

On the carved canopy bed where she had slept for three years, red dates, longans, and peanuts were arranged to spell out the characters May you soon give birth to a noble son.

Meng Ruoli really wasn't picky at all; she could actually bring herself to use the bed she had slept in for three years as a bridal bed.

Lan'er said with extreme indignation, "Young Mistress, has the State Duke's estate really fallen this low? When the Heir marries a new bride, he even uses the room you slept in."

Meng Shuhe let out a cold laugh. "Over a month ago, the Duchess punished me to go recuperate at the country estate under the pretext that I had broken her dowry cup. It turns out it was just to clear the path and make room for them. They truly treated me like a sick cat to be bullied."

When she had first arrived at the country estate, the servants and matrons there had been utterly unreasonable and overbearing.

Later on, she had used her own silver to hire a human trafficker, replaced the entire batch of servants, and traded the original ones off to the trafficker.

Thinking back, those original servants at the country estate must have all been taking orders from the State Duke's estate and Meng Ruoli.

The State Duke's estate dared to be so audacious, sending her a divorce letter the day before marrying a new bride, precisely because they thought that even if she came to make a scene, she would be blocked by those stubborn servants at the manor.

With this thought, Meng Shuhe gave a cold instruction: "Chop up this bed, this round table, and all the furniture inside with wood axes, and take them back to the kitchen at home to burn as firewood."

The servants of the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate looked at each other once more in hesitation, none of them daring to move.

Meng Shuhe took out the small denomination of one hundred taels from the banknotes the Duchess had given her earlier and handed it to the lead servant.

"Take this silver and divide it among yourselves. Lan'er, go to the woodshed and fetch a few wood axes."

Lan'er acknowledged the order and quickly returned with several wood axes.

Meng Shuhe motioned for the servants of the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate to take the axes. "Chop it."

The servants were full of hesitation, but they didn't dare disobey Meng Shuhe's command. They stepped forward and began hacking away at the fine nanmu canopy bed.

"What are you doing?"

Meng Shuhe turned her head and saw the newlywed couple, Meng Ruoli and Shen Qian, standing at the doorway. She smiled faintly and said, "My dowry is too bulky, and it's difficult to move all at once. Since the country estate happens to be short on firewood, I'm chopping up this dowry to take back as kindling."

Meng Ruoli cried out in shock, "This is a canopy bed that took more than a dozen craftsmen fifteen years to make! How can you use it as firewood?"

Meng Shuhe replied, "So what? It's my dowry, and I'm willing to use it as firewood. Does Sister have an objection?"

Meng Ruoli looked pitifully at Shen Qian by her side.

Shen Qian patted Meng Ruoli's hand. "Let's go to the side courtyard. Today is a day of great joy; don't entangle yourself with this shrew."

Meng Ruoli glared at Meng Shuhe with burning jealousy. Let Meng Shuhe act arrogant for one last day; starting tomorrow, she would be a discarded, divorced woman, while she herself would be the lofty wife of the Heir to the State Duke.

Seeing that the dowry had been chopped to pieces and her anger vented, Meng Shuhe returned to the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate.

Since she was leaving Chang'an City and heading to Jiangnan, she naturally needed to inform the Marquis and his wife.

Upon returning to the estate, Meng Shuhe learned that the Marquis and his wife were not at home. Over a month ago, they had received joyous news from her maternal grandfather's family and had gone there to attend a cousin's wedding banquet, and they had not yet returned.

Meng Shuhe suddenly understood why Meng Ruoli and the State Duke's estate dared to show her zero respect and set the wedding date with Meng Ruoli so hastily; it was because the Marquis and his wife were away from home.

When the Marquis and his wife returned, even if they wanted to stand up for her, the raw rice had already been cooked into raw porridge; the divorce and remarriage were already a fait accompli, and at worst, the Duke and Duchess would only receive a few reprimands.

Leaving behind a letter, Meng Shuhe said to Lan'er, "We are returning to Jiangnan."

Lan'er asked, "Young Mistress, why must we return to Jiangnan?"

Meng Shuhe gently stroked her lower abdomen. "The noble families of Chang'an City appear to be wealthy and refined on the surface, but their behind-the-scenes despicable deeds are truly disgraceful. Chang'an City is not a place worth staying in."

More importantly, Meng Shuhe didn't dare to gamble on whether the unborn child's ability to speak was true or false.

If Lu Jing truly was the Crown Prince, and he indeed had a woman he wished to keep pure in his heart, she had ruined his chastity; she couldn't guarantee she wouldn't face retaliation.

Meng Shuhe hadn't stayed long at her maiden home and didn't have much luggage. Although she had plenty of clothes and jewelry at the country estate, with Lu Jing there, she didn't dare go back to retrieve them.

She figured she could simply buy new ones at the shops along the way.

As Meng Shuhe and Lan'er stepped out of the gates of the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate, they happened to run right into the Marquis and his wife, who had just returned.

The Marquis and his wife were both thirty-seven years old, and both possessed exceptionally fine appearances.

Meng Shuhe bore a seventy-percent resemblance to the Marchioness, which was precisely the reason why the Meng family had been certain she was their daughter when they found her.

Seeing Meng Shuhe, the Marchioness smiled and said, "Shuhe, why have you come back to your maiden home today?"

Meng Shuhe said, "Father, Mother, I came today to bid you farewell. I wish to return to Jiangnan."

Upon hearing this, the Marchioness's expression changed. She hurriedly stepped forward, took Meng Shuhe's hand, and asked, "Is Shen Qian going back with you? Why on earth are you suddenly returning to Jiangnan?"

Meng Shuhe certainly couldn't tell them that she might be carrying the reigning Crown Prince's child, and to prevent the two of them from blocking the position of the Crown Prince's favored woman in the future, she had better flee to Jiangnan as soon as possible.

Suppressing her words, Meng Shuhe used a handkerchief to gently dab the corners of her eyes. "Mother, the State Duke's estate is simply too bullying. Under the pretext of mourning over the past three years, Shen Qian refused to step into my chambers, yet he handed me a letter of divorce on the grounds that I had no offspring."

The Marquis said angrily, "How dare Shen Qian divorce you on such grounds? Don't cry, Father will definitely go seek justice for you and will not let you be cast aside."

Meng Shuhe replied, "There's no need. Shen Qian has already married Sister Ruoli as the Heir's wife. I have no wish to entangle myself with them any further; I have already publicly divorced Shen Qian, and I wish to return to Jiangnan to clear my mind."

The Marquis and his wife exchanged a look of shock.

The Marchioness frowned and said, "Ruoli is utterly foolish. Without her parents' command, how could she rashly marry? The State Duke's estate is simply going too far."

With that, the Marchioness patted the back of Meng Shuhe's hand. "Shuhe, it was not easy for you to finally return to your mother's side. Mother cannot bear for you to return to Jiangnan. If you want to clear your mind, going to the estate in the suburbs is the exact same thing."

"Mother, my mind is made up."

Meng Shuhe said softly, "My adoptive sister has stolen my husband, and remarrying will not be easy for me. Staying in Chang'an City will only make me the laughingstock of others. It is better to leave this place of heartbreak sooner rather than later."

The Marchioness sighed. "The road back to Jiangnan is long and arduous. If you return alone, your father and I cannot rest easy. Stay in Chang'an City for now; your parents will definitely find you a better husband than Shen Qian."

chapters.title: Already a Candidate for Crown Princess
chapters.content:
Meng Shuhe gently shook her head and said, "Mother, there is no need. Shen Qian looks down on me because I grew up in a merchant's household, and I imagine other gentlemen will surely look down on me for the same reason. I might as well return to Jiangnan and marry a gentleman there."

The Marquis of Pingyuan's wife grasped Meng Shuhe’s hand tightly, her eyes welling with tears, "Your mother had such a hard time finding you back. We, mother and daughter, haven't even been reunited for a few years; I certainly won't allow you to leave Chang'an and go to Jiangnan."

Seeing tears in the eyes of the Marquis of Pingyuan's wife, Xie Qing'an, Meng Shuhe had no choice but to compromise: "Mother, then I will stay and accompany you for a few more days, but at the latest, I must return to Jiangnan in two months."

Indeed, leaving abruptly today was a bit hasty.

Besides, her father and mother wouldn't let her just walk away.

Travel is expensive even for the poor, so clothing, food, and medicine for the journey back to Jiangnan still needed to be fully prepared.

The last time she came to Chang'an from Jiangnan, she took an official boat. This time, she could only take a merchant vessel back to Jiangnan, which meant she had to buy a few sturdier maidservants and older female attendants, and also hire two martial arts-trained bodyguards for self-defense along the way.

Xie Qing'an firmly grasped Meng Shuhe's hand, "Your father and I certainly wouldn't be at ease with you returning to Jiangnan alone. Furthermore, your adoptive parents' family merely runs a dim sum stall; if you go back to Jiangnan, I'm afraid you won't live a very good life."

Meng Shuhe chuckled lightly, "Mother, I have plenty of silver now. Since the Shen family treated me this way, they must compensate me properly. Therefore, I demanded a compensation of one hundred thousand taels of silver from them."

Xie Qing'an was surprised, "One hundred thousand taels? The Duke Shen's Mansion could actually produce one hundred thousand taels of pure silver just like that?"

Meng Shuhe took out the silver banknotes to show Xie Qing'an. "So Mother need not worry that I will live a life of poverty upon returning to Jiangnan."

"Father, Mother, you're finally back."

Meng Wang's voice came from the courtyard entrance.

Wearing a blue robe, Meng Wang strode across the courtyard gate. Catching sight of the Marquis and Marchioness of Pingyuan, he immediately started complaining, "Father, Mother, this Meng Shuhe was raised in the countryside, completely devoid of manners and extremely greedy! Just now, she actually extorted one hundred thousand taels of silver from the Duke of Zhenguo's Mansion!"

Meng Wang glared angrily at Meng Shuhe, and seeing the banknotes in her hand, said, "With such a large sum of silver, you ought to return it to the Shen family."

"Why should I?" Meng Shuhe gave a light scoff, "These one hundred thousand taels are what the Shen family owes me. Not only did they waste three years of my time in vain, but they also saddled me with the reputation of a divorcee, making it all the more difficult for me to find a husband in the future. This compensation is simply what the Shen family rightfully owes me."

Meng Wang retorted, "If you had any self-awareness regarding your marriage, would finding a husband be difficult?

As a girl raised in the countryside, even marrying the son or nephew of a low-ranking official in Chang'an City would be considered marrying above your station.

Yet you had the pipe dream of becoming the wife of a Duke's heir! It is the height of absurdity."

"It's making me furious to death!"

Lu Xiu expressed his indignation from within Meng Shuhe's womb, "My mother could even be the Crown Princess; why on earth is she not worthy of being a Duke's heir's wife? How is that a pipe dream?"

"If that scoundrel Lu Jing hadn't acted like a beast and, for the sake of the woman in his heart, nearly cost us mother and son our lives, Mother, you should have entered the palace to become the Crown Princess and given them a thorough thrashing!

It's a pity Lu Jing is hardly a decent man either; we mother and son had better not pick this fight and just save our little lives first."

Hearing her unborn baby's furious voice, Meng Shuhe looked at her parents and then at Meng Wang. Only she could hear this voice.

"Wang'er!" The Marquis glared angrily at Meng Wang, "Your younger sister is the daughter of our Marquis of Pingyuan's Mansion. How is marrying the heir of the Duke of Zhenguo marrying above her station? Why must she only marry the offspring of some humble household?"

Meng Wang said, "Father, your and Mother's partiality should have its limits. You feel guilty and want to compensate her, but you must also look at how unpresentable her actions are!

To extort money from the Duke of Zhenguo's Mansion in broad daylight is simply going too far. Which prominent, noble family would be willing to marry in such a greedy and vulgar woman?"

The Marchioness of Pingyuan said angrily, "Meng Wang, hush your mouth. Your father and I haven't even blamed you yet.

While your father and I were away from home, you actually married Ruoli off to Shen Qian? And you condoned the Shen family in divorcing your own sister?

When we left, we specifically instructed you to take good care of your two sisters. Is this how you take care of them?"

Faced with the Marchioness's reprimand, Meng Wang only replied, "Mother, this marital engagement was originally meant for Ruoli and Shen Qian. It was Meng Shuhe who insisted on forcefully inserting herself in the middle to break up a mandarin duck couple; I was merely righting a wrong."

Xie Qing'an said angrily, "Righting what wrong? Go to the ancestral hall and kneel in penishment for a night."

"Mother!"

The Marquis glared angrily at Meng Wang, "Your mother's words carry no weight, do they?"

Daring not to defy the Marquis and Marchioness of Pingyuan after all, Meng Wang had no choice but to go to the ancestral hall to kneel. As he left, he shot Meng Shuhe one more vicious glare.

Xie Qing'an held Meng Shuhe's hand and led her into Jinxiu Pavilion, saying, "This was your room before you got married; not much has changed. Just settle in here comfortably for now, and don't dwell on returning to Jiangnan."

Meng Shuhe did not argue further with Xie Qing'an and replied, "Mother, then I shall stay in the residence for a short while."

Once she had fully prepared the boats, clothes, food, and servants for returning to Jiangnan, she would quietly slip away. By then, even her parents trying to stop her would be useless.

After Xie Qing'an left, Meng Shuhe only felt relieved that she had not previously revealed her identity as the daughter of the Marquis of Pingyuan to Lu Jing.

Lu Jing only knew that she had been married and was divorced yesterday, but he did not know she was the daughter-in-law of the Duke of Zhenguo's Mansion.

As for the servants in the country estate, they had all been replaced, and they only knew her as their mistress without knowing her true identity.

---

In the country estate on the outskirts of Chang'an City.

Lu Jing read books in the room until dusk fell and the lamps were lit, yet Meng Shuhe still had not returned. His cold, deep, phoenix-like eyes narrowed slightly.

From waking up early in the morning, neither Meng Shuhe nor her maid was anywhere to be seen, and even by nightfall, there was still no sign of her return.

Could it be that Meng Shuhe slept with him, refused to take responsibility, and simply ran away?

Just like four years ago, leaving Jiangnan without a single word of greeting, vanishing without a trace.

Lu Jing put down his book and called out to the guards outside, "Wende."

A dark shadow entered from outside and knelt before Lu Jing, "Your Highness, what are your orders?"

"Get up. Go and investigate where your mistress is and why she hasn't returned yet."

"Yes."

Lu Jing continued to flip through the book in his hand.

After waiting for about an hour, Wende entered from outside and reported, "Your Highness, the secret guards have come to report that the mistress has gone back to stay at her maiden home."

Lu Jing raised his eyes to look at Wende, "Maiden home? She went back to Jiangnan?"

Wende said, "Your Highness, the mistress should be the true daughter whom the Marquis of Pingyuan's Mansion found four years ago. At this moment, she has already rested at the Marquis of Pingyuan's Mansion."

Lu Jing smiled, "She turned out to be the daughter of the Marquis of Pingyuan's Mansion after all? Return to the palace."

It was already deep into the night by the time Lu Jing rode back to the Eastern Palace.

The moment he returned to the palace, Lu Jing saw Empress Qin, wearing a high bun and brocaded purple robes, entering the hall.

"Mother Empress."

Lu Jing bowed respectfully.

Upon seeing Lu Jing, Empress Qin let out a complaint, "Where on earth did you go? For the past two days, you haven't been seen anywhere! People try to find you without even knowing your whereabouts."

Lu Jing smiled faintly and said, "Your son has had important matters to attend to these past few days. If Mother Empress has any instructions, you can simply have Wen Lu relay them."

Empress Qin said, "Seeing that you are nearing twenty, the matter of taking a Crown Princess cannot be delayed any longer. Your imperial elder sister is holding a poetry gathering at her private residence on the third day of the third lunar month, the Shangsi Festival, inviting all the young maidings of Chang'an City. On the third day of the third month, you will go to your sister's private residence and carefully select a Crown Princess."

Lu Jing smiled faintly, "Mother Empress, this son already has a candidate for Crown Princess."

The Empress asked curiously, "Who is it?"

Lu Jing's thin lips parted slightly as he said, "It is the daughter of the Marquis of Pingyuan's Mansion."
