chapters.title: The Crown Prince Selects a Consort
chapters.content:
Empress Qin arched her slender eyebrows. "The daughter of the Marquis of Pingyuan's Mansion? The Marquis of Pingyuan only has one daughter; if I recall correctly, her age seems to be about the same as yours. Is she still unmarried?"

Lu Jing smiled faintly, "She is also nineteen, and currently unbetrothed."

Empress Qin said, "Then I shall have Jiayu send an invitation to the Marquis of Pingyuan's Mansion, inviting the young lady of the Marquis to attend the Shangsi Festival poetry gathering hosted by your imperial sister. Let your sister vet her first and see whether the Marquis's daughter is worthy of being the Crown Princess."

Lu Jing said, "Mother Empress, I have already decided that only the daughter of the Marquis of Pingyuan will be my Crown Princess."

Empress Qin remarked, "The Marquis and Marchioness of Pingyuan are exceptionally good-looking; their daughter must naturally possess extraordinary beauty as well, though I didn't pay much attention during previous palace banquets."

Lu Jing chuckled softly, "To say she has the appearance of an immortal and a beauty that could topple a state would not be an exaggeration."

Empress Qin glanced at Lu Jing, "It's rare for a woman to catch your eye, so this palace would also like to take a look at her. On the day of the Shangsi Festival, I shall also go to your sister's private residence to behold this ethereal beauty."

---

Back in the Marquis of Pingyuan's Mansion, Meng Shuhe tossed and turned, unable to fall asleep. She simply called out softly to the child in her womb.

"Lu Xiu, are you still awake?"

A child's milky voice sounded, "Mother, are you unable to sleep?"

Suddenly having a child, and moreover, the Crown Prince's child; she truly couldn't fall asleep.

"Little Xiu, who is the woman your father fancies? Do you know?"

Lu Xiu shook his head and said, "I don't know. Lu Jing hid her extremely well, but there are still quite a few people who knew that Lu Jing had a woman kept deep in his heart. Because of her, Lu Jing's inner court had no other consorts or concubines aside from you."

Meng Shuhe was startled, "Isn't he the Crown Prince? How could the Eastern Palace backyard have no other secondary consorts or concubines? Even Shen Qian had two concubine-maids long before marriage."

Lu Xiu explained, "Lu Jing was simply deeply devoted to the woman in his heart, keeping himself pure for her sake and unwilling to touch other women.

The only reason he married you as Crown Princess was simply because of a premarital pregnancy. After you entered the palace, Lu Jing rarely favored you."

Meng Shuhe coughed twice, "Does a child like you even understand what 'favoring' means?"

Lu Xiu said, "I am fourteen years old, of course I understand. 'Favoring' means going to your palace. I've read Lu Jing's Diary of Activities and Repose; after he ascended the throne, he never once went to your palace."

Thinking that discussing such matters with her unborn son was highly inappropriate, Meng Shuhe burst into another fit of light coughs.

Diverting the topic, Meng Shuhe asked, "Since Lu Jing is so fond of that woman, why didn't he marry her as Crown Princess in the first place?"

Lu Xiu whispered, "It was simply because the background of the woman Lu Jing fancied was too humble. Grandfather Emperor and Grandmother Empress would certainly never allow a woman of humble birth to become the Crown Princess.

As a result, Lu Jing was nearing twenty without ever marrying.

Then you got him drunk and became pregnant with me. Grandfather Emperor felt your background was decent, so he elevated you to Crown Princess on account of the child's mother.

Later, Grandfather Emperor passed away, and Lu Jing ascended the throne as the Master of All Under Heaven. With no one left to manage his marriage, he wanted to make the two of us, mother and son, step aside to make room for the woman of his heart.

On the day I was forced to kneel in punishment, the woman he favored seemed to have already conceived a child.

At that time, I heard Lu Jing ask the imperial physician whether it would be more difficult for a woman over thirty to bear a child, so the woman he kept hidden away in his heart must have already inherited the imperial bloodline."

Meng Shuhe gently placed her hand on her lower abdomen, "How can you address him directly by his full name, Lu Jing? He is your father after all."

"I don't recognize him as a father."

Lu Xiu let out a soft huff after speaking.

Meng Shuhe gave a helpless, wry smile, "Put that way, it really is best to stay far away from Lu Jing."

Lu Xiu hurriedly chimed in, "Right, let's hurry and escape back to your hometown in Jiangnan."

Meng Shuhe fell into deep thought. Although Lu Jing did not know she was the young lady of the Marquis of Pingyuan's Mansion, he did know her residence in Jiangnan.

However, since Lu Jing had a woman he adored, he surely wouldn't take her to heart or come searching for her whereabouts.

Thinking and thinking, Meng Shuhe gradually drifted off into a deep sleep.

Early the next morning, Meng Shuhe woke up early once again, intending to head out to the streets to procure some clothes needed for the journey.

Traveling from Chang'an City back to Jiangnan by boat would take at least two to three months.

The journey would happen to coincide with the transition from spring to summer, and since there was still a lingering spring chill, she couldn't afford not to prepare clothes for three seasons.

Besides, she was now pregnant. She remembered seeing her adoptive mother lose her appetite when pregnant with her younger brother in her childhood, so she also had to prepare some candied fruits and sour preserves.

After dressing up, Meng Shuhe took Lan'er to the streets and purchased quite a few sets of clothes as well as some winter fabric materials.

Fearing that life on the boat would be dull, Meng Shuhe thought she could make a few outfits for the little Lu Xiu in her womb while on board.

Lan'er asked in puzzlement, "Mistress, it's already the end of the second month; why are you still buying these winter clothing materials?"

"Buying winter clothing materials now is cheaper."

Meng Shuhe gently stroked her lower abdomen. Now was the end of the second month, meaning by the time little Lu Xiu was born, it would happen to be winter. These fabrics would be just right for making clothes for him.

When Meng Shuhe returned to the Marquis of Pingyuan's Mansion, just as she stepped inside, the Marchioness of Pingyuan, Xie Qing'an, walked up to her and said, "Shuhe, Mother was just about to look for you."

Meng Shuhe smiled faintly and said, "Does Mother have something on her mind?"

Xie Qing'an brought over an invitation card and said, "Shuhe, Princess Jiayu just had someone send you an invitation, inviting you to attend a poetry gathering at her private residence on the third day of the third month, the Shangsi Festival."

Meng Shuhe took the invitation from Xie Qing'an with both hands and asked, "Mother, can I not go?"

Xie Qing'an said, "This is an invitation issued by Her Royal Highness the Princess; one cannot simply not go."

"But..." Meng Shuhe was afraid of running into Lu Jing, "Mother, could I perhaps claim to be ill?"

Xie Qing'an smiled faintly, "There's really no need to fake an illness. For this poetry gathering hosted by Princess Jiayu, composing poetry is secondary; the most important thing is selecting a Crown Princess for the Crown Prince.

Therefore, many young ladies and noble matrons will attend this Shangsi Festival poetry gathering, along with numerous young talents and scions of aristocratic families.

Since you have just divorced Shen Qian, you might as well go and take a look. Perhaps you can encounter a young talent far better than Shen Qian..."

Meng Wang's voice sounded from behind them, "Mother, you'd better not let Meng Shuhe go make a fool of herself at the poetry gathering. Raised in the countryside, what does she know about poetry? Won't she just make our Marquis of Pingyuan's Mansion a laughingstock once again?"

Meng Shuhe heard a wave of annoyed noise from the fetus in her womb: "It's making me furious to death, thank goodness this person dies early!"

Meng Wang continued, "Mother, besides, this invitation might not even be for Meng Shuhe.

I just heard a maidservant say that the invitation reads 'Miss Meng, Daughter of the Marquis of Pingyuan'. I imagine this invitation was meant for Ruoli.

It's just that Princess Jiayu didn't know Ruoli got married yesterday, which is why she sent the invitation to our residence."

Meng Shuhe handed the invitation to Meng Wang, "You're right, this invitation must be for younger sister Ruoli. Hurry and send this invitation to the Duke of Zhenguo's Mansion for Meng Ruoli."

Meng Shuhe certainly had no wish to attend the poetry gathering hosted by Princess Jiayu. What if she ran into Lu Jing at the gathering?

Meng Wang took the invitation, looked coldly at Meng Shuhe, and said, "You actually show some self-awareness this time. I'll go deliver the invitation to Ruoli right away."

---

At the Duke of Zhenguo's Mansion.

Meng Wang handed the invitation to Meng Ruoli, saying, "Sister, this is an invitation sent by Princess Jiayu, inviting you to attend the Shangsi Festival poetry gathering on the third day of the third month."

Meng Ruoli smiled faintly, "I actually have a share in this too? I heard that this Shangsi Festival poetry gathering is meant for selecting a consort for the Crown Prince?"

Meng Wang nodded slightly, "Yes."

Meng Ruoli looked at the gold-embossed invitation. She had long since heard about Princess Jiayu hosting the Shangsi Festival poetry gathering.

She never expected that she, an adopted daughter of a Marquis's household, could still receive an invitation to the Crown Prince's consort selection.

Meng Ruoli did not regret getting married yesterday, nor did she lament missing out on the position of Crown Princess.

After all, although she was raised and nurtured by the Marquis of Pingyuan's Mansion, she was not of their bloodline after all. With an unclear background, she could never be the Crown Princess.

Being able to become the wife of the Duke's heir now was already exceedingly good.

The status of a Duke's heir's wife was something Meng Shuhe could only look up to with dust in her eyes, forever unable to surpass.

chapters.title: Returning Home for the Three-Day Visit
chapters.content:
On the first day of the third lunar month, early morning was filled with a flurry of birdsong.

Meng Shuhe walked over to the lattice window and pushed it open, immediately greeted by the fragrance of flowers. In the courtyard, magnolias, peonies, and herbaceous peonies were blooming in competition, while the weeping crabapples already had flower buds waiting to burst open.

Meng Shuhe sat before the bronze mirror, letting Lan'er style her hair.

"My mother is so pretty, as beautiful as a flower, making fish sink and geese drop from the sky!"

Hearing the praise of her looks from the child in her belly, Meng Shuhe smiled softly.

"It's just that Lu Jing is blind. My mother is so stunning, yet in his heart he still likes someone else."

Meng Shuhe looked at her finished self in the bronze mirror and said to Lan'er, "Go pick a peony. Today's hair bun will match a peony just right."

"Yes," Lan'er replied.

After Lan'er left, Meng Shuhe gently stroked her lower abdomen and asked, "Since Lu Jing deeply loves that woman, why doesn't he give her a proper title? Even if her humble birth prevents her from becoming the Crown Princess, she could still become a Crown Prince's Secondary Consort."

Lu Xiu gave a light hum. "Lu Jing wouldn't bear to let the woman he fancies play a humble, subservient role in front of you."

Meng Shuhe chuckled lightly. "Lu Jing is certainly exceptionally good to the woman he fancies."

Once Meng Shuhe had pinned the peony into her hair, she and Lan'er prepared to head out to the streets again to purchase items for the journey back to Jiangnan.

Just as Meng Shuhe reached the main gates of the Marquis's estate, she saw that the front doors of the residence were flung wide open today.

Meng Wang was waiting at the entrance dressed in a crimson brocade robe, looking as though he were welcoming distinguished guests.

Before long, Shen Qian was supporting Meng Ruoli across the threshold of the Marquis's estate. The husband and wife looked deeply affectionate.

As soon as Shen Qian stepped inside, his eyes landed on Meng Shuhe, who had a peony pinned in her hair.

Today, Meng Shuhe was wearing a goose-yellow gown, looking bright, unrestrained, and radiant. The peony in her hair made her beauty outshine the flower itself, and Shen Qian could not help taking a few extra glances.

Catching Shen Qian's gaze, Meng Ruoli gave a light cough. "Your Grace!"

Shen Qian withdrew his gaze, cupped his hands in a salute to Meng Wang, and said, "Brother, today I have brought Ruoli back to visit her maiden home for the third-day ritual."

Meng Wang smiled lightly. "Please, come right in. Grandmother has been longing for you."

Meng Shuhe had no desire to watch their display of deep sibling affection. Just as she was about to step outside, Meng Wang called out to stop her.

"Meng Shuhe, where are you going? Today is our sister's return visit, what does it look like for you to be heading out?"

Meng Shuhe turned back to glance at Meng Wang, treating his words as wind passing her ear.

Seeing that Meng Shuhe still intended to leave, Meng Wang was exceedingly annoyed.

Meng Ruoli walked up to Meng Shuhe and said, "Sister, are you still blaming me? But Chenglang and I were a couple promised in marriage from the start... Our sisterly bond shouldn't be frayed because of a man."

Meng Shuhe said, "A good dog doesn't block the path. Move aside."

Looking pitiful and wronged, Meng Ruoli said, "Sister, why are you treating me this way? I've never done anything to wrong you. How can you scold me as a dog for no reason? We are sisters after all."

Meng Shuhe retorted, "Who is a sister to you? You think you're worthy of being my sister?"

Furious to the extreme, Meng Wang snapped, "Meng Shuhe! How is Ruoli not worthy of being your sister? If anyone is unworthy, it is you who aren't worthy of being Ruoli's sister!

Raised in the countryside without a shred of manners, Ruoli is the exemplary noble lady of Chang'an carefully cultivated by our Marquis's estate. Just who is the unworthy one here?"

"Such a fine exemplar of a noble lady."

Meng Shuhe chuckled lightly. "Meng Ruoli talks marriage with a brother-in-law who has not yet divorced, and left her maiden home without the command of her parents, what kind of exemplary noble lady is that?"

Meng Ruoli sobbed softly, "Sister, my marriage was also decided by Grandmother. It was Grandmother who consented to this match.

Sister, today I am returning home, why must you humiliate me so?"

Weeping softly, Meng Ruoli added, "If Sister dislikes me, then I suppose I should just leave."

Meng Wang quickly chimed in, "You are certainly not the one who should leave, Ruoli. You are now the Hereditary Princess Consort of the Defense Commissioner's Manor; the Marquis's estate would never sever ties with you. Grandmother has also been waiting for you for a long time, hurry and go inside."

Shen Qian gently consoled Meng Ruoli, saying, "Don't keep Grandmother waiting too long."

Meng Ruoli wiped the aggrieved tears from the corners of her eyes with a handkerchief and followed Shen Qian to the Pine and Crane Courtyard where the Old Dowager of the Marquis of Pingyuan resided.

Seeing Meng Ruoli approach, the Old Dowager of the Marquis of Pingyuan smiled faintly. "Ruoli, you have finally returned."

"Greetings, Grandmother."

Meng Ruoli and Shen Qian both bowed in salute to the Old Dowager of the Marquis of Pingyuan.

Looking at the tears at the corners of Meng Ruoli's eyes, the Old Dowager said with a heart-pangs of distress, "My darling, why are you crying? Did the Heir of Shen bully you?"

Meng Ruoli shook her head. "Grandmother, His Grace treats me exceptionally well. It's just that when I returned to the estate just now, I ran into Sister. Perhaps Sister still harbors misunderstandings toward me, so she spoke a few unkind words...

I don't blame Sister; after all, it is indeed I who failed her. Actually, I shouldn't be crying either, it's only natural that she doesn't want me to be the young lady of the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate."

"How is it that you failed her?"

The Old Dowager comforted Meng Ruoli, saying, "Ruoli, don't listen to the ramblings of that ill-mannered country bumpkin. Although you are not our Meng family's biological daughter, you were raised and nurtured by this old woman's own hands; you are the true young lady of our Marquis's estate."

"Someone come, go summon Meng Shuhe here. This old woman must teach her some manners properly."

Meng Wang said, "Grandmother, Meng Shuhe went out early this morning, and we don't know where she went."

Leaning heavily on her walking cane with annoyance, the Old Dowager of the Marquis of Pingyuan said, "When she returns, make her come straight to my Pine and Crane Courtyard. A daughter raised by country merchants simply has no manners to speak of. No wonder she was cast aside by her husband; this old woman is going to teach her some proper discipline."

"Yes, Grandmother."

---

Meng Shuhe strolled around the streets and bought a fair amount of fabric. Spending the silver given by the State Duke's Manor really didn't pain her heart at all.

One hundred thousand taels of silver, more than enough for her to squander for a lifetime.

"Mother, the crucian carp soup at the Baiwei Pavilion at the street corner is exceptionally delicious. I used to go there often. Turns out this restaurant was already around fifteen years ago."

Hearing the words of the child in her belly, Meng Shuhe figured that since Meng Ruoli was visiting her maiden home today, the Meng family would inevitably gather for a family meal.

She had no desire to return to the Meng family to dine at the same table as Meng Wang, Shen Qian, and the others, so she decided to go to Baiwei Pavilion for her meal.

Meng Shuhe found a corner seat and sat down. Following the menu dictated by Lu Xiu in her belly, she ordered, "Waiter, I'll have a bowl of crucian carp soup, roasted suckling pigeon, stir-fried shrimp with clear sauce, and a bowl of seasonal vegetables."

No sooner had Meng Shuhe finished ordering than she heard a familiar voice coming from nearby; it was the voice of Lu Jing's pageboy, Wen De.

"Waiter, are there any private rooms left?"

The waiter replied, "You're out of luck, honored guest. All the private rooms are full, and the very last table in the main hall was just taken a moment ago. You'll have to wait a quarter of an hour for a table to open up."

Lu Jing, standing beside Wen De, looked toward Meng Shuhe, who was seated in the corner, and said, "I know that young lady. We can just share a table with her."

Meng Shuhe tried her best to block her profile with her sleeve, never expecting that Lu Jing would have already spotted her.

"Talk about stepping out without checking the almanac."

Meng Shuhe heard the voice of Lu Xiu from within her belly: "Why did we run into Lu Jing here?"

Hearing the child's voice, Lu Jing looked all around. The child's voice seemed to be coming from right beside Meng Shuhe.

Yet there were no young children or toddlers around Meng Shuhe. Could it be that he had heard wrong?

Lu Jing sat down right beside Meng Shuhe and asked, "Why didn't you return to the estate these past two days? You gave me quite a search."

Meng Shuhe raised her eyes and looked Lu Jing up and down. Today, Lu Jing was dressed in a purple brocade robe, which set off his elegant and refined demeanor, like a jade tree facing the wind. His features grew increasingly handsome, and Lu Jing clearly possessed an unspeakable aristocratic air.

Meng Shuhe couldn't help kicking herself for failing to notice in the past that Lu Jing carried such an aloof and distinguished aura of one holding supreme power.

Had she known he was the Crown Prince and already had someone in her heart, she never would have flirted with him. Alcohol truly ruins matters.

"I had some business in Chang'an City these past two days, so I didn't return to the estate."

With that, Meng Shuhe picked up her teacup and took a light sip.

Lu Jing leaned close to Meng Shuhe's ear and whispered, "So you had business in the city. I thought you had taken my chastity, were unwilling to take responsibility for me, and had run off to escape..."

"Cough, cough, cough!"

Hearing these words from Lu Jing, Meng Shuhe choked on a mouthful of tea.

chapters.title: Discussing Marriage
chapters.content:
Lu Jing gently patted Meng Shuhe's back to help her smooth her breath. "Drink slowly."

Meng Shuhe raised her eyes to look at Lu Jing, who was close enough to touch. Judging by his expression, was he truly here to settle accounts with her for taking his chastity?

Yet rather than being angry that she took his innocence, he wanted her to take responsibility?

Lu Jing asked, "What business did you have in Chang'an City these past few days? Do you need my help?"

Meng Shuhe shook her head. "No need, it's already been resolved."

The waiter brought over several dishes. Meng Shuhe looked at the food before her, the crucian carp soup was not white at all, and a single sniff revealed a heavy fishy odor.

Meng Shuhe scooped up a bowl and took a light sip, frowning slightly. The little brat in her belly had lied to her; this crucian carp soup tasted utterly terrible, and the stir-fried shrimp was equally fishy.

Having eaten only a little to line her stomach without any appetite, Meng Shuhe thought about returning to the Meng family. As she stood up, she saw Lu Jing following closely by her side.

Meng Shuhe halted her steps and asked, "Young Master Lu, why are you following me?"

Lu Jing said, "I'll escort you back. Where are you staying in Chang'an City?"

Meng Shuhe dared not let Lu Jing know that she was the young lady of the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate, so she said, "I'm returning to the estate in the countryside."

Lu Jing looked at Meng Shuhe and said, "My carriage is right over there. Let's head back to the estate together."

Before boarding the carriage with Lu Jing, Meng Shuhe whispered a few words into Lan'er's ear, instructing her to go to the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate to inform them that she had gone to the country estate to recuperate.

The moment Meng Shuhe stepped inside the carriage carriage, she was pulled directly into Lu Jing's embrace.

Falling abruptly into Lu Jing's arms, Meng Shuhe caught a faint, clean fragrance wafting past her nose. "Young Master Lu, what are you doing? Let me go quickly."

Lu Jing did not release Meng Shuhe. Instead, he lowered his head and murmured near her ear, "You're still calling me Young Master Lu? Have you forgotten what you called me the night before last?"

Meng Shuhe truly had no wish to recall the events of the night before last, and she felt the tips of her ears burn red.

Giving a light cough, Meng Shuhe said, "Young Master Lu, both of us were drunk the night before last. Let's treat everything that happened that night as forgotten, and pretend it never happened at all."

Lu Jing's phoenix eyes narrowed slightly. "Never happened? You took my chastity of nineteen years, how can you pretend it never happened?"

Meng Shuhe gave a dry cough. Was Lu Jing seriously going to settle accounts with her for taking his chastity?

"Young Master Lu, I was drunk that night and truly muddle-headed from the wine. It wasn't intentional on my part to take your purity."

Meng Shuhe added, "I, I... let's just pretend that night was nothing more than a dream, and neither of us needs to pester the other."

Lu Jing said coldly, "You took my chastity, how can you brush it off with the excuse of being drunk?"

Meng Shuhe whispered, "Then how about I give you ten thousand taels of silver as compensation?"

Ten thousand taels of silver was by no means a small sum.

Lu Jing was amused to the point of laughter. "My chastity is only worth ten thousand taels of silver?"

Meng Shuhe asked, "Then in Young Master Lu's view, how should I compensate you?"

"Give me a proper title."

Lu Jing looked at Meng Shuhe and said, "Marry me."

"You mustn't agree to him! Mother, you absolutely cannot marry Lu Jing. If you marry Lu Jing, your whole life will be ruined!"

Hearing the child's voice, Lu Jing frowned slightly. He looked at Meng Shuhe in his arms and asked, "Did you hear the voice of a young toddler just now?"

Not expecting that Lu Jing could also hear the voice of the little brat in her belly, Meng Shuhe shook her head slightly and said, "I didn't hear anything. Didn't Young Master Lu sleep well last night, perhaps suffering from auditory hallucinations?"

The interior of the carriage was clear at a glance, with no child in sight. Lu Jing could only suspect that he was indeed hearing things.

Lu Jing grasped Meng Shuhe's hand and said, "Since you and I have already crossed that line and completed the rites of husband and wife, you must give me a proper title and marry me..."

Meng Shuhe pulled her hand away. "Young Master Lu, matters of marriage require the command of one's parents and the words of a matchmaker. My parents are still down in Jiangnan, and this marriage must wait until I write a letter to consult my father and mother before I can say."

"Your parents are in Jiangnan?"

Lu Jing gazed deeply at Meng Shuhe. Was she so unwilling to disclose to him that she was the young lady of the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate?

Meng Shuhe nodded. "That's right. Didn't you already know? My parents are in Jiangnan."

Lu Jing smiled faintly and said, "Very well, once we return to the estate later, you can write a letter back to Jiangnan to discuss our marriage with your parents."

Meng Shuhe looked at Lu Jing. "Young Master Lu, if you want to marry me, you too must have the command of your parents. You should also go back and discuss our marriage with your father and mother..."

Lu Jing smiled faintly. "My parents have long been urging me to marry; they will certainly consent to our match."

Meng Shuhe paused in slight confusion. Didn't the little brat say that Lu Jing had another true love, and was only forced to marry her out of desperation because of an accidental pregnancy? This didn't quite seem to match up, did it?

---

The Marquis of Pingyuan's Estate.

The members of the Meng family were dining together in the Hall among Flowers.

When Lan'er entered and saw the family beaming with smiles and laughter, she felt a surge of injustice for Meng Shuhe.

"Marquess, Marchioness, my young mistress sent me to pass along a message. She isn't feeling well these past few days, so she wishes to go to the country estate to stay for a few days and clear her mind."

Hearing Lan'er's words, Xie Qing'an cast a complicated look toward Shen Qian and Meng Ruoli, ultimately able only to sigh.

"Lan'er, take good care of your young mistress."

"Yes," Lan'er acknowledged.

Meng Ruoli glanced at the retreating figure of Lan'er, her heart filled with smug triumph.

No matter how arrogant Meng Shuhe was, wasn't she still forced to slink away back to the country estate in defeat?

She herself was now the Hereditary Princess Consort of the Defense Commissioner's Manor, and in two days she would even be attending Princess Jiayu's poetry gathering, whereas Meng Shuhe was only fit to hole up in that country estate, too ashamed to show her face in public.

---

Meng Shuhe felt full of preoccupation all the way in the carriage. Upon returning to the estate, she went straight into her own room and bolted the doors and windows tightly.

"Little Xiu, are you still there?"

"Mother, don't believe Lu Jing's words. You absolutely cannot marry him."

Sitting on the small couch, Meng Shuhe said, "Yet I feel like Lu Jing isn't at all like what you described. It doesn't seem like he's being forced to marry me just because of the child.

Lu Jing doesn't even know I'm the young lady of the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate yet, and he's still willing to marry me. The idea that the woman he fancies has too humble a birth to become the Crown Princess doesn't quite hold water either..."

Lu Xiu gave a light hum. "Hmph, Lu Jing is the most scheming of all. He must have planted secret guards around you; chances are he already knows you're the young lady of the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate."

"Huh? Secret guards?" Meng Shuhe was startled. "What are secret guards?"

Lu Xiu explained, "Secret guards are specially trained guards in the imperial family who hide in the shadows to monitor and protect others, coming and going without a trace."

Meng Shuhe said, "Still, I feel like Lu Jing doesn't seem to be marrying me against his will..."

Lu Xiu retorted, "He is marrying you against his will! Didn't you hear Lu Jing say just now that his Grandfather and Grandmother have long been pressing him to marry?

Since Lu Jing can't marry the woman he truly fancies, what choice does he have but to first find a woman who can placate Grandfather, just to stop Grandfather from bestowing a marriage upon him with some true aristocratic noble lady?

Mother, although you also come from a noble family, you were raised in the countryside and can't stir up any waves in the inner courts of the Eastern Palace, unlike some young ladies in Chang'an who have harbored ambitions of entering the palace since childhood and know how to win people over in the Eastern Palace.

Moreover, the Marquis of Pingyuan's estate clearly favors that fake daughter, and you have no maternal clan to rely upon. Thus, you are Lu Jing's ideal candidate for Crown Prince's Consort to use in placating Grandfather, someone he can easily manipulate at will."

Meng Shuhe sank back into deep thought. Even though she came from a prominent aristocratic family, she was raised in the countryside and easy to manipulate, yet she was a second-marriage bride.

As the Crown Prince, how could Lu Jing, who couldn't marry his humble-born true love as Crown Princess, turn around and marry a woman who was previously married?

Though her mind was chaotic, drowsiness overtook her, and amidst her pondering, she drifted off to sleep on the small couch.

She did not wake until dusk.

When Meng Shuhe woke up and opened the door, she happened to run into Lu Jing coming to see her.

Seeing Meng Shuhe with her hair in a loose bun and a sleepy-eyed expression, Lu Jing smiled faintly. "Did you just wake up from an afternoon nap?"

Meng Shuhe gave a soft hum of assent.

Lu Jing walked up beside Meng Shuhe and said, "It's time for you to write a letter to your parents to discuss our marriage."

Looking into Lu Jing's deep, phoenix-like eyes, Meng Shuhe asked aloud, "Lu Jing, since you and I are now talking marriage, I haven't asked you yet: where are you from? How many brothers do you have in your family? And what does your father do for a living?"

chapters.title: Attending a Poetry Gathering
chapters.content:
Lu Jing said, "My parents are both from Chang'an."

Meng Shuhe looked up at Lu Jing: "Your parents are actually from Chang'an? Then why did you tell me over a month ago that you came to Chang'an to take the imperial examinations, had your silver stolen, and had nowhere to go? Lu Jing, you actually lied to me!"

Meng Shuhe's eyes were filled with the sadness of being deceived by Lu Jing: "In that case, there is no need for our marriage to be discussed in letters sent back to Jiangnan with my parents. I will not marry someone who lies to me."

Lu Jing said in a low voice, "Could it be that you have never lied to me?"

Meng Shuhe looked up into Lu Jing's phoenix eyes and said, "When have I ever lied to you?"

Lu Jing lowered his head and murmured in Meng Shuhe's ear, "Are your parents really in Jiangnan?"

Meng Shuhe took two steps back. Looking at Lu Jing's scrutinizing gaze, she couldn't help but recall what the Zaidai had said about the hidden guards.

Did Lu Jing truly already know her identity as the eldest daughter of the Pingyuan Marquis?

Lu Jing continued to explain in a gentle voice, "I didn't deliberately lie to you about coming to Chang'an for the examinations. I just wanted to stay at the estate so I could spend more time catching up with you, so please don't mind."

Lu Jing reached out and stroked Meng Shuhe's hair bun, which was disheveled from her afternoon nap: "The day after tomorrow, my elder sister is holding a poetry gathering at her residence. I will take you to meet my sister and my mother first."

Meng Shuhe asked, "Your elder sister?"

Lu Jing replied, "Mhm. There are four siblings in my family in total. My elder half-brother is six years older than me, my eldest sister is five years older than me, and I also have a younger brother born of the same mother who is two years younger than me.

"The day after tomorrow happens to be the third day of the third month. My sister is holding the Shangsi Festival poetry gathering at her manor, so it's just the right time to take you to meet her."

Meng Shuhe looked at Lu Jing and said, "Can I not go to your sister's poetry gathering?"

Lu Jing said, "You took my innocence, so you must take responsibility and give me a proper status. Just come with me to meet my mother and sister and finalize our marriage."

Meng Shuhe took a deep breath. Was Lu Jing's statement reversed?

For a moment, Meng Shuhe began to doubt once again whether he was truly the Crown Prince.

If he were the Crown Prince, the rightful heir to the Eastern Palace, why would he need her to give him a status?

Lu Jing added, "It's time for dinner. I noticed earlier that you didn't eat much at lunch, so eat a bit more later."

Meng Shuhe was indeed hungry. She had her maid fetch warm water so she could wash up and fix her loose hair bun before going with Lu Jing to the dining hall to eat.

The dinner was lavish, and Meng Shuhe calmed her mind, what will be, will be; for now, filling her stomach was the most important thing.

As for Lu Jing wanting to marry her, sovereigns and subjects have their proper places. Since he was the crown prince, it wasn't as simple as her saying she wanted to escape and being able to do so.

Even if she fled to Jiangnan, Lu Jing knew her residence there.

Even if she could escape to an unfamiliar place elsewhere, she couldn't just abandon her adoptive parents back in Jiangnan.

For now, she would just take it one step at a time.

After finishing dinner, seeing Lu Jing follow her back to her room, Meng Shuhe lifted her gaze and said, "Young Master Lu, it's getting late. You should go back to your own room."

Lu Jing said, "It's still early for bed. How about a game of chess?"

Meng Shuhe yawned. "I'm sleepy. Let's play chess tomorrow instead."

With that, Meng Shuhe shut the door tightly, locking Lu Jing out.

As soon as Meng Shuhe lay down on the bed, she heard the voice of the Zaidai in her belly: "Mother, you truly cannot marry Lu Jing!"

Meng Shuhe sighed, "Sigh, whether I marry Lu Jing or not is not something I have the final say on.

"He is the Crown Prince of the Eastern Palace. If he stubbornly insists on marrying me as the Crown Prince's Consort to appease His Majesty for the sake of the person he holds in his heart, and begs for an imperial decree to make me the Crown Prince's Consort, could I possibly defy an imperial edict?"

Lu Xiu said, "Mother, why don't we escape back to Jiangnan tonight? Before His Great-Grandfather issues the decree making you the Crown Prince's Consort."

Meng Shuhe said softly, "I cannot escape. Lu Jing knows my residence in Jiangnan.

"Besides, didn't you also say that Lu Jing might have planted hidden guards around me? How could I possibly escape from Chang'an under the noses of those hidden guards?"

Lu Xiu asked in confusion, "How would Lu Jing know where you live in Jiangnan? Did you and Lu Jing know each other before?"

Meng Shuhe replied, "Mhm. Lu Jing and I knew each other back in Jiangnan. We both studied at Wanhe Academy, and I suppose you could say I was his senior fellow apprentice."

"I actually didn't know about this!" Lu Xiu took a deep breath and said, "If His Great-Grandfather issues the imperial decree, are you really going to marry Lu Jing? Lu Jing is truly not a good match."

Meng Shuhe said, "Little Xiu, whether I marry the Crown Prince or not is not something I can control. However, I don't think His Majesty would agree to let a woman who has been married twice become the Crown Prince's Consort.

"You also said before that I relied on my child to gain status, which is why His Majesty allowed Lu Jing and me to marry because of the pregnancy.

"In this lifetime, as long as I conceal the fact that I am carrying you in my belly, His Majesty and the Empress may not necessarily agree to let a twice-married woman become the Crown Prince's Consort.

"Let's just take things one step at a time; when we reach the bridge, the boat will naturally straighten itself out."

Lu Xiu sighed. "Sigh, I really don't want Lu Jing to be my father."

"Is he very bad to you?" Meng Shuhe felt a pang of heartache.

Lu Xiu nodded. "Mhm. He is not good to me at all. He doesn't like you, so out of hatred for the house, he loathes me just as much."

Meng Shuhe gently stroked her lower abdomen and said, "It's alright. We simply won't like Lu Jing either."

---

Pingyuan Marquis Manor.

On the day of her return visit to her maiden family, Meng Ruoli stayed until after dinner before reluctantly bidding farewell to the Old Dowager of the Pingyuan Marquis Manor in the Songhe Courtyard.

The Old Dowager of Pingyuan Marquis Manor took Ruoli's hand and said, "Ruoli, you must serve your parents-in-law well and assist your husband at the State Duke's Manor."

"Yes, Grandmother."

The Old Dowager of Pingyuan Marquis Manor asked again, "Did Princess Jiayu give you an invitation to the Shangsi Festival poetry gathering on the third day of the third month?"

Meng Ruoli replied, "Yes."

The Old Dowager of Pingyuan Marquis Manor said, "I heard that Princess Jiayu is holding this poetry gathering to select consorts for the Crown Prince. Your cousin Yunlan has already turned fifteen.

"It's a pity your second uncle's official rank is a bit low, so she didn't receive an invitation to the poetry gathering. Do you think you could bring your sister Yunlan along when you go to the poetry gathering the day after tomorrow?"

Meng Ruoli looked slightly troubled. "Grandmother, of course it is fine to bring sister Yunlan along.

"Only, Grandmother, Qianlang's full sister Shen Xi also received an invitation to the Princess's poetry gathering.

"Shen Xi is the legitimate daughter of the State Duke's Manor. When it comes to the Crown Prince's consort selection, I'm afraid sister Yunlan falls short of Shen Xi in every aspect."

The Old Dowager of Pingyuan Marquis Manor smiled lightly and said, "Naturally, I never expected your sister Yunlan to become the Crown Prince's Consort.

"We daughters of the Meng family do not aim for such grand fortunes; it would already be exceptionally good if she could be selected as a Concubine of the Crown Prince.

"As for your sister-in-law Shen Xi, if she is fortunate enough to become the Crown Prince's Consort, wouldn't it also be good for her to have an extra concubine in the Crown Prince's inner courtyard to support her?"

Meng Ruoli smiled faintly. "Very well, Grandmother. On the third day, before I go to the Crown Prince's poetry gathering, I will come to the Marquis Manor to pick up sister Yunlan. Grandmother, you must make sure sister Yunlan is properly dressed up."

If Meng Yunlan were truly selected as a Crown Prince's Concubine, she would also owe her a favor.

Meng Yunlan had not been on good terms with Meng Shuhe these past few years. The feud between the two had long been established because Meng Yunlan and Meng Shuhe's maid Lan'er shared the same name.

Meng Yunlan could be said to utterly detest Meng Shuhe. If Yunlan were to truly become a Crown Prince's Concubine...

With Meng Shuhe acting so arrogant and offending a Crown Prince's Concubine, she would likely be forced to hide away in a rural estate in the countryside for the rest of her life in disgrace.

However arrogant and overbearing Meng Shuhe was these past few days, the more miserably she would weep in the days to come.

A girl from the countryside was lacking in upbringing and etiquette after all, thinking she was something special just because she was the legitimate daughter and true young miss of the Marquis Manor.

Little did she know she had already completely offended the nobles around her.

chapters.title: The Crown Prince of the Current Dynasty
chapters.content:
On the third day of the third month, the spring scenery was delightful, and peonies and herbaceous peonies blossomed in brilliant competition.

Early in the morning, Meng Yunlan woke up promptly and went to Old Madam Meng's Songhe Courtyard.

Seeing her granddaughter Meng Yunlan approach, the Old Dowager of the Pingyuan Marquis Manor smiled lightly and said, "My Lan'er is becoming more and more beautiful, turning into a proper young lady. This pink dress today makes you look so tender and delicate. If I were the Crown Prince, I definitely wouldn't be able to look away."

"Grandmother, you're just teasing me."

The Old Dowager of Pingyuan Marquis Manor looked at Meng Yunlan with great satisfaction. "Grandmother is not teasing you. Both you and Ruoli grew up by my side and were raised by my hand. Now that your sister Ruoli has successfully married the heir of the State Duke's Manor as his wife, Grandmother also hopes that you can find a good destination.

"The current Crown Prince is nearly twenty years old, and there are still no concubines in the Eastern Palace's inner courtyard. You are so beautiful, and a delicately raised young miss of our Marquis Manor; entering the Eastern Palace will surely win you the Crown Prince's favor."

Hearing this, Meng Yunlan lowered her head, looking very bashful. "Grandmother."

Lady Meng, the senior, smiled lightly. "You don't need to be shy. This lilac-colored dress was made when your aunt was young for attending a palace banquet. Later, she didn't go to the banquet, so it was put aside.

"Don't look at how many years have passed; the cloud brocade fabric is of the highest quality. Later, you will wear this outfit to the poetry gathering; don't lose face for the Marquis Manor."

Meng Yunlan's gaze shifted to the cloud brocade on the tray held by the maid behind the Old Dowager. She smiled faintly and said, "Thank you, Grandmother. I'll go change my clothes right now."

---

At the estate.

Meng Shuhe slept until the chen hour (around 8 AM) before waking up. After washing up, she pushed open the window to breathe in the breath of spring.

In the courtyard of the estate, the begonia flowers were in full bloom.

Meng Shuhe stood at the window looking at the begonia flowers for a moment before she saw Lu Jing entering through the moon gate.

Lu Jing was holding a lilac-colored shimmering brocade dress. Under the morning sun, the shimmering brocade cast brilliant multicolored lights, resembling the sparkling surface of water under the sunlight.

Lu Jing handed the shimmering brocade to Meng Shuhe and said, "This is a dress made for you by the embroiderers in my family. Put it on and attend today's poetry gathering."

Meng Shuhe stood at the window and sighed softly, "I've caught a slight cold today, so I won't be going to the poetry gathering."

"You caught a cold?" Lu Jing raised an eyebrow. "I'll have a doctor come take a look at you."

Meng Shuhe rested her hand on the window frame, suddenly remembering that she was already pregnant. She wondered if a doctor taking her pulse would be able to detect a pregnancy pulse, and whether having carried this Zaidai for just six days could be discovered.

Yet, Meng Shuhe certainly dared not take that risk.

"No need, I'll be fine after a little rest."

Lu Jing said, "One shouldn't conceal an illness from a doctor."

"I am already well and can go to the poetry gathering, but I don't want to wear this shimmering brocade; it's too eye-catching."

Lu Jing smiled lightly, "Wearing this shimmering brocade today won't be too eye-catching at all."

Meng Shuhe said, "I can just wear my newly made pomegranate skirt."

Lu Jing draped the shimmering brocade dress over the window frame and said, "Very well, I'll wait for you in the carriage."

Meng Shuhe looked at Lu Jing's retreating figure and sighed.

After Lu Jing had walked far away, Lu Xiu said, "Mother, you could have rejected him and not gone to the poetry gathering."

Meng Shuhe said, "Even if I reject it today, there will eventually come a day I cannot refuse. If I claim to be ill and he brings an imperial physician to take my pulse, it will definitely be discovered that I am carrying you..."

Lu Xiu fell silent for a moment, and Meng Shuhe went to change her clothes. The outfit she put on was a pomegranate-red spring blouse and skirt; although the fabric was not top-tier, its color was exceptionally striking.

Lu Xiu said, "Mother, I've thought of a way for you to avoid marrying Lu Jing."

"What way?"

Lu Xiu suggested, "In these next couple of days, before the palace issues an imperial decree for the bestowal of marriage, you could first find a husband and get married."

"How can I get married while carrying you?" Meng Shuhe said softly. "Isn't that asking some young gentleman to take a wife and get a child bundled together for free?"

Lu Xiu said, "It doesn't have to be a real marriage, even getting engaged would work.

"The reason Lu Jing wants you to be his Crown Prince's Consort right now is definitely because he was driven to a corner by His Great-Grandfather. To protect the woman he holds in his heart, he wants to marry you first to stall His Great-Grandfather.

"As long as you are already engaged, could Lu Jing possibly snatch another man's wife?

"Lu Jing is about to turn twenty, and His Great-Grandfather must be pressing him urgently to appoint a Crown Prince's Consort. Seeing that you are already engaged, Lu Jing will choose another girl as the Crown Prince's Consort to stall His Great-Grandfather."

Meng Shuhe smiled faintly. "That's a good idea, though I wonder where to find this fiancé?"

Lu Xiu said, "Find a poor scholar from a humble family. When the Crown Prince's Consort is already decided, you can break off the engagement with him and just give him five thousand taels of silver as a reward. I'm sure that poor scholar would be more than happy to do it!"

Meng Shuhe smiled faintly. "That's not a bad idea either. Besides, spending the Shen family's money is something one really doesn't feel any heartache over."

Meng Shuhe didn't bother much with makeup; she styled her hair into a cloud bun, pinned an agate peach blossom hairpin, and went out to board the carriage.

As soon as she entered the carriage, Lu Jing looked at Meng Shuhe before him, momentarily unable to look away. "You look so radiant in red."

Meng Shuhe sat down and said, "If I wear clothes of other colors, am I suddenly not radiant?"

Lu Jing replied, "They look good too, but there is no woman in this world more beautiful than you."

Hearing Lu Jing's words, Lu Xiu couldn't help but angrily say, "Sweet-talking, smooth-tongued, full of lies."

Lu Jing looked around and saw no child present, so he furrowed his brows slightly. What was wrong with him these past few days?

Why did he keep hearing the voice of a child?

Meng Shuhe looked at Lu Jing and asked, "Young Master Lu, where does your elder sister live? Since she is five years older than you, she should already be married, right?"

Lu Jing shook his head and said, "She hasn't married yet."

Meng Shuhe was quite curious. "At twenty-four, why hasn't she married?"

Lu Jing smiled faintly. "Because the man she holds in her heart has reached the pinnacle of official posts, and she cannot marry him."

"Why?"

Meng Shuhe was full of curiosity again. "Why can't she marry someone who has reached the pinnacle of official posts? Since he has reached the pinnacle of official posts, wouldn't marrying him be exceptionally good? Is it because your sister's background is too humble?"

Meng Shuhe thought to herself that shouldn't be the case either; Zaidai said Lu Jing was the Crown Prince of the Eastern Palace, so could his sister be an Imperial Princess?

Lu Jing looked into Meng Shuhe's eyes and said, "Earlier, I never told you what my parents do..."

Meng Shuhe asked, "Then what do your parents do?"

Lu Jing looked deep into Meng Shuhe's eyes and said, "My father is the current Emperor, and my mother is the current Empress."

Meng Shuhe had long since learned of Lu Jing's identity from Zaidai's mouth, so hearing him say this now, she wasn't surprised at all. "Oh."

Seeing Meng Shuhe's calm expression, Lu Jing asked, "Did you already know my identity?"

Meng Shuhe replied, "How could I have known your identity beforehand?"

Lu Jing said, "Then why do you show no sign of surprise? And knowing I am an imperial prince, why don't you kneel and pay homage?"

Meng Shuhe reacted, realizing her reaction was indeed far too calm, so she said, "Young Master Lu, then do you know who my father is?"

"Who?"

Lu Jing was also waiting for Meng Shuhe to confess to him that she was the young miss of the Pingyuan Marquis Manor.

Meng Shuhe said, "If your father is the Emperor, then my father is the Jade Emperor in heaven. I am the Jade Emperor's daughter, one of the Seven Fairies. Now that this immortal maiden is here, you mortal men should also kneel and pay homage to me."

Lu Jing looked at Meng Shuhe, the corners of his lips curving slightly upward. "I didn't lie to you. I really am the current Crown Prince of the Eastern Palace."

Meng Shuhe slowly said, "If you truly were the Crown Prince of the Eastern Palace, why would you come to my estate claiming to have nowhere to go and freeloading meals? That shows you're just making things up. It's still less believable than me saying I'm the Jade Emperor's daughter."

Lu Jing said, "I haven't lied to you. Once you go to my eldest sister's manor later, you will know that I truly am the crown prince of the current dynasty..."

chapters.title: Unrequited Love
chapters.content:
At the entrance of the Marquis of Pingyuan’s estate.

Meng Ruoli sat quietly inside the carriage, waiting for her younger cousin, Meng Yunlan, to arrive.

The maid standing beside the carriage felt a deep sense of injustice on Ruoli’s behalf. "My lady, it should have been you attending today’s selection banquet. With your looks, you undoubtedly could have become a consort in the Eastern Palace."

Meng Ruoli offered a faint smile. "Is becoming an Eastern Palace consort really that easy? With the Crown Princess above and flocks of swallows and orioles filling the inner palaces below, you might not even catch a glimpse of His Royal Highness the Crown Prince all year round. It’s far more comfortable and carefree to be the wife of a Duke’s heir."

"My lady, this servant heard that the current Crown Prince is exceptionally handsome, possessing the peerless, ethereal beauty of an immortal. I wonder if we might have the chance to set eyes on him later?"

As the mistress and servant spoke, Meng Yunlan emerged from the mansion’s gates. She was wearing a lotus-root pink, cloud-brocade, chest-high ruqun. The shimmering play of light on the fabric caused Meng Ruoli to narrow her eyes slightly.

"Elder sister."

Meng Yunlan climbed into the carriage and smiled lightly at Meng Ruoli.

Ruoli took Yunlan’s hand and smiled. "You look so gorgeous today, Younger Sister. Once His Royal Highness the Crown Prince sees you, he will surely fall deeply in love with you."

Yunlan felt terribly embarrassed, blushing as she replied, "Sister, you’re just teasing me."

Meng Ruoli smiled with utmost dignity. "Sister is not teasing you at all. As sisters of many years, our bond naturally cannot be compared to those halfway-acquaintance sisterhoods. Sister genuinely hopes you make a high match."

Yunlan knew that the "halfway-acquaintance sisterhood" Ruoli referred to meant Meng Shuhe.

"Sister, Meng Shuhe doesn't even have the face to show herself in public these days. Abandoned and cast aside as a discarded wife, she still has plenty of suffering ahead of her. If she has any sense, she'll hide in that rural estate for the rest of her life."

Ruoli quickly chided, "Sister, she is still our elder sister, after all. It’s not right to speak of her that way."

"Elder sister? She’s hardly worthy!" Yunlan retorted. "Raised in the countryside, she completely lacks manners and upbringing."

"I am her true, direct cousin, yet she refused even to let her maid Lan'er change her name! If I manage to enter the Eastern Palace, the very first thing I'll do is force Meng Shuhe to change her name to match my maid's!"

When the carriage arrived at the street outside Princess Jiayu’s private residence, about a li away from the estate, the guards of the princess's manor instructed Meng Ruoli and Meng Yunlan to descend and walk the rest of the way.

Just as Ruoli and Yunlan stepped down from their carriage, they happened to see another carriage approaching, completely unadorned with any aristocratic family crest.

Yet, at a single glance, Meng Ruoli recognized that the maid sitting outside the carriage was none other than Lan'er, who belonged to Meng Shuhe.

"Lan'er?"

Yunlan asked, "Sister, what is it?"

Ruoli looked toward the nearby guard and asked, "Why is that carriage not required to stop here, but allowed to go straight to the private residence?"

The guard replied, "That is a distinguished guest of Her Royal Highness the Princess. Naturally, her carriage is permitted to drive directly into the inner grounds."

Meng Ruoli frowned slightly, thinking to herself: Could it be that that maid merely looked like Lan'er?

After all, there was simply no way Meng Shuhe could possibly be a distinguished guest of the Princess.

---

The carriage came to a stop. When Meng Shuhe alighted, she realized she had already arrived inside the private residence. The back courtyard used for parking carriages was exceptionally spacious.

"Younger Brother."

Hearing a woman's voice, Meng Shuhe turned her gaze sideways and saw a lavishly dressed woman approaching with slow, graceful steps, her hair adorned with numerous golden hairpins and jade ornaments, clad in a magnificent purple gown.

Wen De, a guard beside Lu Jing, bowed to the approaching woman. "Greetings, Your Royal Highness the Princess."

Seeing Lu Jing, the retinue of maids and servants following the woman immediately dropped to their knees in salute. "This servant greets His Royal Highness the Crown Prince."

Lu Jing said placidly, "Rise."

Shuhe gazed at the sea of kneeling servants, then slowly lifted her eyes to look at Lu Jing.

Lu Jing reached out and grasped Shuhe’s slender wrist. "Surely now you believe me; that I truly am the Crown Prince?"

Taking a deep breath, Meng Shuhe jerked her hand free from Lu Jing’s grip, vexed. "You really are the Crown Prince? Then why on earth did you deceive me for a whole month? And you still claimed you weren't lying to me; you deceived me from the very beginning!"

"As a towering Crown Prince, how could you stoop to deceiving me like this?"

Meng Shuhe’s face was plastered with the heartbroken expression of someone who had been thoroughly duped by Lu Jing.

"Younger Brother, what is the meaning of this?"

Princess Jiayu walked up to Meng Shuhe, carefully scrutinized her features, and chuckled softly, "Are you perhaps the legitimate daughter of the Marquis of Pingyuan?"

Meng Shuhe was momentarily stunned. The little bun in her belly had been right: this scoundrel Lu Jing really had known all along that she was the daughter of the Marquis of Pingyuan.

Lu Jing lowered his gaze at Shuhe with a leisurely expression and asked, "And you? As the legitimate daughter of a Marquis's estate, how could you stoop to deceiving me like this?"

Shuhe demanded, "How did you know I was a Marquis's daughter?"

Lu Jing replied in a low voice, "Never mind how I knew. Do you know the crime of deceiving the heir apparent?"

Meng Shuhe gave a light cough. "Well, isn't it true that ignorance of the law excuses one? Besides, you deceived me as well; I didn't deliberately mean to hide the truth from you. Can't we just call our mutual deception even?"

Lu Jing curved his lips into a smile. "Very well, even."

Princess Jiayu’s gaze shifted back and forth between Meng Shuhe and Lu Jing. "What deception?"

Shuhe bowed to Princess Jiayu and said, "Greetings, Your Royal Highness. It is merely a misunderstanding between His Highness the Crown Prince and myself."

Princess Jiayu smiled faintly. "You truly possess the looks of a peerless beauty capable of toppling cities and states. No wonder the Crown Prince praised you so; it turns out not to have been an exaggeration at all."

Lifting her eyes, Meng Shuhe replied with a light smile, "You flatter me, Your Royal Highness. If I can topple cities, then Your Highness's beauty is enough to captivate all living beings."

Jiayu smiled. "You certainly have a sweet tongue. Come with me to the poetry gathering; it's bound to be quite lively today."

Lu Jing said to Princess Jiayu, "Imperial Elder Sister, I leave Shuhe in your care. I won't be attending the poetry gathering."

Princess Jiayu frowned slightly. "How can you not attend? Today's gathering was specifically arranged for you to select a Crown Princess."

"Has she not already been chosen?" Lu Jing looked into Meng Shuhe's eyes. "Therefore, I will not go."

Jiayu replied, "Very well, do as you please."

Princess Jiayu led Meng Shuhe toward the courtyard where the poetry gathering was being held.

Glancing sideways at the Princess's face, Shuhe recalled that Princess Jiayu and Lu Jing were full sister and brother born of the same mother.

While that scoundrel Lu Jing was exceptionally good-looking, Princess Jiayu surpassed even him.

Radiating the natural nobility of an imperial princess, combined with such breathtaking features, Shuhe thought it was no wonder she had never married.

Whichever husband she might choose to marry would reap an absolute bargain.

Princess Jiayu turned her head toward Meng Shuhe and smiled lightly, "My younger brother rarely loses his heart to a woman. You are only the second woman he has insisted on taking as his Crown Princess. He has truly invested genuine affection in you."

Meng Shuhe pondered the word "second" in the Princess's remark...

She voiced her question: "Your Royal Highness, if I may be so bold, who was the first woman the Crown Prince insisted on taking as his Crown Princess, and why didn't Your Highness marry her?"

"That young lady got married."

Princess Jiayu explained, "The Crown Prince didn't manage to go and propose in time; that woman had already married someone else, and no one even knows where she ended up."

Shuhe heard the voice of little Lu Xiu in her belly: "So the woman Lu Jing holds a candle for wasn't just of humble birth; she was even a second-time bride."

Meng Shuhe lowered her head in contemplation. An unrequited love from his youth would forever remain a lifelong regret for Lu Jing.

No wonder that later on, in order to make room for his beloved in the position of Eastern Palace Empress, he would end up taking the lives of her and her child!

Shuhe felt that the little bun in her belly was right: taking advantage of these two days before the imperial decree was issued and the marriage was finalized, she needed to hurry and secure a betrothal with some poor scholar to prioritize saving her own life.

"Your Royal Highness, the Princess of Zheng has arrived."

Princess Jiayu said to Shuhe, "Shuhe, the courtyard right ahead is where the poetry gathering is being held. Please feel free to amuse yourself while I go receive the Princess of Zheng."

"Very well."

Accepting the instruction, Meng Shuhe walked alone toward the courtyard of the gathering.

Along the way, little Lu Xiu said in her belly, "So Lu Jing never even got what he wanted with the woman he fancied. Who knows, maybe later he resorted to seizing a minister's wife; that must be why he keeps the identity of his beloved so tightly under wraps!"

Shuhe muttered, "Let's just stay far away from him."

As Meng Shuhe admired the peonies and Chinese roses blooming in the courtyard, she soon heard a familiar, sneering voice.

"Meng Shuhe? Why on earth are you also here at the Crown Prince’s selection banquet?"

Lifting her eyes, Shuhe saw Meng Ruoli and Meng Yunlan approaching.

Once Yunlan finished speaking, she continued with a taunt: "You discarded, abandoned wife, aren't you ashamed to show your face here?"
